milestones.title: Milestone 7: Verification Tool Ecosystem Expansion
milestones.description: Expand Telchines tool interoperability across simulation, lint, formal, waveform/debug, and hardware-design workflow tooling so it can interpret and orchestrate a broader verification toolchain.

issues.title: Define the verification and hardware tool interoperability roadmap
issues.body: Survey and prioritize the external tools Telchines should understand or orchestrate across simulation, lint, formal, waveform/debug, synthesis-adjacent checks, and regression infrastructure. Define the first adapter tiers, normalized output contracts, and selection criteria for what counts as a supported tool.

issues.title: Expand simulator adapter coverage beyond the current MVP set
issues.body: Add support for more commonly used simulation tools and normalize their execution and result artifacts into Telchines workflows.

issues.title: Add richer formal-tool interoperability and result normalization
issues.body: Broaden formal-tool support and normalize counterexamples, proof summaries, and failure artifacts for replayable workflows.

issues.title: Add regression manager and test-runner integration points
issues.body: Integrate with broader regression managers and test runners so Telchines can operate over larger verification environments without bespoke wrappers.

issues.title: Define criteria and contracts for community-contributed tool adapters
issues.body: Specify the adapter interface, artifact contracts, and support expectations for externally contributed verification tool integrations.

milestones.title: Milestone 9: External Knowledge Grounding and RAG
milestones.description: Expand retrieval beyond project-local memory with external verification knowledge sources while preserving provenance, policy controls, and measurable grounding quality.

issues.title: Define external knowledge corpus policy and source types
issues.body: Specify which external verification documents, tutorials, standards excerpts, and domain references Telchines may ingest, along with freshness, licensing, and policy constraints for using them in retrieval workflows.

issues.title: Add ingestion pipeline for external verification docs into retrieval index
issues.body: Build a repeatable ingestion path for approved external verification references so they can be chunked, indexed, refreshed, and queried alongside project-local material.

issues.title: Separate project-memory retrieval from external-doc retrieval modes
issues.body: Make retrieval workflows explicitly distinguish project-local memory from external-domain knowledge so grounding, ranking, and policy decisions stay transparent and controllable.

issues.title: Attach source provenance and citation metadata for external-doc evidence
issues.body: Store enough metadata for each external retrieval hit to show where it came from, when it was ingested, what policy bucket it belongs to, and how it should be cited in user-facing evidence packs.

issues.title: Add retrieval eval cases for external-doc grounding quality
issues.body: Extend the retrieval benchmark suite with cases that measure whether external-domain references improve grounding quality without crowding out higher-value project-local evidence.

milestones.title: Milestone 10: Workflow Expansion Beyond SVA
milestones.description: Add the next product-spec workflows beyond repair, triage, and spec-to-SVA, starting with DUT-to-cocotb scaffolding and coverage-closure assistance.

issues.title: Define DUT-to-cocotb scaffold contract and acceptance criteria
issues.body: Specify inputs, outputs, artifact layout, evidence expectations, and validation criteria for generating a first-pass cocotb scaffold from DUT context.

issues.title: Implement DUT-to-cocotb scaffold prototype
issues.body: Build the initial workflow that generates a reviewable cocotb scaffold from DUT context and stores the resulting artifacts in the run store.

issues.title: Add benchmark cases for DUT-to-cocotb scaffold quality
issues.body: Create benchmark fixtures and scorecards that measure structural usefulness, grounding quality, and validation outcomes for generated cocotb scaffolds.

issues.title: Define coverage-closure input and output contract
issues.body: Define the accepted inputs, suggested outputs, evidence requirements, and report schema for a first coverage-closure assistant workflow.

issues.title: Build first coverage-closure assistant workflow
issues.body: Implement a baseline workflow that consumes coverage reports and related evidence, proposes prioritized closure actions, and stores the resulting plan in replayable run artifacts.

milestones.title: Milestone 8: Interactive CLI UX
milestones.description: Turn Telchines into a persistent interactive CLI with session state, slash commands, and an in-process shell experience.

issues.title: Improve shell command autocomplete and contextual suggestions
issues.body: Add command-aware autocomplete, contextual suggestions, and shell-native discovery hints so common slash commands and workflow arguments are easier to enter interactively.

issues.title: Add @file mentions and project-aware reference insertion in the shell
issues.body: Support project-aware file mentions and reference insertion inside the Telchines shell so users can target files and artifacts more fluidly during interactive work.

issues.title: Add richer keyboard shortcuts and command palette interactions
issues.body: Introduce keyboard-driven shell affordances such as command palette interactions, structured pickers, and richer shortcut handling for the full-screen shell.

issues.title: Define a broader interactive shell UX roadmap for Codex-like affordances
issues.body: Document and prioritize future shell UX work such as autocomplete, @file mentions, contextual pickers, richer panels, and Codex-like interaction patterns for the Telchines terminal experience.
